title: Joint faithfulness of finite evaluations with finite shifted reduction Hom
statement:
theorem integralSystemReduction_map_ext_of_finite
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {A B : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X}
    (p q : A ⟶ B)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Finite
      (A.obj⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧ ⟶ (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E X n).obj B.obj))
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map p) =
        (finiteSystemDerivedEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) X n).map
          ((integralSystemReduction l E X).map q)) :
    (integralSystemReduction l E X).map p =
      (integralSystemReduction l E X).map q

source.place: Lemma map-into-Rlim; finite-group Mittag-Leffler vanishing. This is a proved sufficient criterion accompanying a disputed unrestricted assertion.

proof.text: Naturality of integralSystemReductionEvaluation identifies each finite evaluated map, conjugated by its comparison isomorphism, with scalar reduction of the underlying integral map. Cancel the comparison at the source to transport the given equalities.

Apply derivedComplete_finiteReduction_ext to the underlying maps, the target completeness property, and the displayed finite shifted-Hom hypothesis. The faithful full-subcategory inclusion gives p=q; apply the coherent reduction functor.

proof_origin.place: Lemma map-into-Rlim; reuse the existing proved generic finite-reduction detection theorem.
